basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old digital marketing intern living in Austin, Texas. I recently discovered the world of energy drinks and supplements, and I'm loving the variety. I enjoy outdoor activities like hiking and camping, which is how I stumbled upon the 'airstream' subreddit. In my free time, I play bass guitar in a local Thin Lizzy cover band. I'm generally online in the evenings after work. I'm currently single and live with a couple of roommates.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in marketing, and I'm currently working as an intern at a digital marketing agency. Most of my knowledge comes from online research and hands-on experience in my internship. I'm also self-taught in playing the bass guitar, learning mostly through YouTube tutorials.
